info.title: Test-Pilot API
info.description: REST API for Test-Pilot. Authenticate with the JWT returned by sign-in or sign-up. Agent tokens are additionally supported for single test-flow runs. The MCP transport is documented separately in docs/mcp-v1-design.md.

servers.description: Current server; override with your Test-Pilot base URL when importing the spec.

bearerAuth.description: Use the token returned by sign-in or sign-up. Send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

agentTokenAuth.description: Agent token. Accepted by POST /api/test-flows/{id}/runs only on the REST API; other REST endpoints require the sign-in JWT.

plainTextToken.description: Only returned once — store it securely
